\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $\sqrt{3x+18}=x$

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item []
\begin{eqnarray*}
\left(\sqrt{3x+18}\right)^{2} & = & x^{2}\\
3x+18 & = & x^{2}\\
0 & = & x^{2}-3x-18\\
0 & = & (x-6)(x+3)
\end{eqnarray*}
So $x=6$ and $x=-3$ are \emph{possible }answers. Checking we find
that 
\[
x=-3\Rightarrow\sqrt{9}=3\neq-3\mbox{ so }x=-3\mbox{ is NOT an answer, and}
\]
\[
x=6\Rightarrow\sqrt{36}=6\checkmark
\]
So $x=6$.\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\item $6x^{\nicefrac{5}{2}}-12=0$

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item []
\begin{eqnarray*}
6x^{\nicefrac{5}{2}} & = & 12\\
x^{\nicefrac{5}{2}} & = & \frac{12}{6}\\
\left(x^{\nicefrac{5}{2}}\right)^{\nicefrac{2}{5}} & = & \left(2\right)^{\nicefrac{2}{5}}\\
x & = & 2^{\nicefrac{2}{5}}=\sqrt[5]{2^{2}}=\sqrt[5]{4}
\end{eqnarray*}
Note that: $\left(x^{\nicefrac{5}{2}}\right)^{\nicefrac{2}{5}}=x^{\nicefrac{5}{2}\cdot\nicefrac{2}{5}}=x^{1}$.\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\item $|x+1|+5=3$

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item []
\[
\left|x+1\right|=-2
\]
We need to solve for two cases 
\[
\begin{array}{rr}
x+1=2\mbox{;} & x+1=-2\\
x=1 & x=-2
\end{array}
\]
Checkin these answers we find that $\left|1+1\right|=2\neq-2$ and
$\left|-2+1\right|=1\neq-2$. So there is no solution.\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}
